elements.description: A compact AI chat card with suggestions, a growing prompt field and dictation.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The assistant's name, in the header

properties.name: greeting
properties.description: Big line on the welcome screen

properties.name: suggestions
properties.default: ["Polish my email", "Make it shorter", "Fix the tone", "Draft a reply"]

properties.name: respond
properties.description:
Your answer for a message – return text or a promise of text. A rejected promise shows an error and lets the
message be sent again. `signal` aborts when the chat is reset or the element is removed. Without it a sample
writer answers (and warns once, unless `demo` is set). `history` is the conversation so far, ending with this message

properties.name: messages
properties.description: The conversation. Changed by the element unless a tc-messages-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: draft
properties.description: Text in the prompt field. Changed by the element unless a tc-draft-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: speech
properties.description:
"auto" uses real speech recognition when the browser has it and shows an error otherwise (or plays the sample
take with `demo`); "simulate" always plays a sample take

properties.name: demo
properties.description:
Demo mode: the sample writer answers without a warning, and dictation plays the sample take where the browser
has no speech recognition

properties.name: dictation
properties.default: "Write a friendly reminder that the report is due on Friday"

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-messages-change
events.description: A message was added or the chat was reset ({ messages }: ChatMessagesChange, the whole conversation); cancelable

events.name: tc-draft-change
events.description: The text in the prompt field changed ({ draft }: ChatDraftChange); cancelable

props.name: messages
props.description: The conversation (controlled) – read it, seed it or restore it; new messages are asked for through `onMessagesChange`

props.name: onMessagesChange
props.description: Called with the whole conversation whenever a message is added or the chat is reset

props.name: defaultDraft
props.description: Starting text in the prompt field when `draft` isn't controlled

changelog: writing-assistant: dictation fills the field and no longer sends by itself.
